chunks: And it has been narrated in another report:
Indeed, the worst of places are the houses of the rulers who do not judge with the truth.
ai.seo_question: Why are the assemblies of unjust rulers condemned in hadith?
ai.summary: This report condemns the places associated with rulers who fail to judge by truth and justice. It reflects a strong moral and legal disapproval of association with corrupt authority and unjust judgment.
